items.description: The report does not establish whether `_transferFrom` is the only relevant path or whether other upstream zero-address validation exists; the plan assumes nothing blocks the recipient.
transferFrom authorization requirements are not detailed; caller_authorized is a coarse Boolean covering owner-or-previously-approved-operator.
Whether a veNFT owned by address(0) could later be recovered is unspecified, so no recovery predicate is modeled for the ownership-zero impact.
No real transfer to address(0) is shown as observed; the zero-address recipient is a potential input, not an observed event.
